model: Aurora UPC, Single Compressor Rooftop Unit with Economizer
applies_to: WaterFurnace single-compressor water-source rooftop units with an economizer, Aurora controls and the Aurora UPC.
summary: BACnet objects of the Aurora UPC on a WaterFurnace single-compressor rooftop unit with an air-side economizer, software version 1.01. Besides occupancy, setpoints and alarms it covers the economizer (outdoor and return air temperature and humidity, enthalpy, damper position), demand controlled ventilation, ECM blower and variable speed pump settings.
notes: PL1250EW holds two separate tables, single and dual compressor; this file is the single compressor table.
Object names are the sheet's reference names.
Many points are marked 'do not map' in the source and are listed only for completeness.
Alarm codes come from the alarm table printed for the dual-compressor rooftop; mode numbers from the single column of the mode table.
Transport and network settings come from the Aurora UPC Application and Troubleshooting Guide (AG1568EW), which is written for the single-compressor water-to-air UPC.

source.title: UPC BACnet Points List For Single/Dual Compressor Rooftop Economizer

integration.summary: Keep BV 502 at External and command occupancy on MSV 500; the UPC holds the occupied, unoccupied and standby setpoints (AV 511-516) and runs the economizer itself. Read MSV 100 for the operating mode and AV 119 for the combined alarm code. BV 110-115 let the BAS send Y1, Y2, W, O, G and DH calls directly.

minimum_points.name: schedule_select_c
minimum_points.why: Must be External for BAS occupancy commands

minimum_points.name: alarm_reset_c
minimum_points.why: Reset manual-reset alarms (On, then back to Off)

integration.enable: BV 502 schedule_select_c picks the internal schedule (Mon-Fri 7:30-17:00 EST) or external BAS commands; External is the listed default. Occupancy commands go to MSV 500, or to AV 509 after BV 504 is set to AV; BV 506 is a separate binary BAS occupancy signal. BV 101 em_shutdown_c shuts the unit down and BV 105 load_shed_c sheds the compressor.
integration.remote_sensors: AV 502 zone_temp_ovrd_c replaces the zone sensor once BV 500 is set to BAS. Outdoor air temperature and humidity, and return air temperature and humidity, can come from the BAS on AV 606, 609, 614 and 617 when BV 609, 611, 613 and 615 are set to BAS. AV 602 (pressure) or AV 603 (elevation), chosen by BV 608, feed the enthalpy calculation. AV 504, 506 and 508 accept humidity, CO2 and VOC values.
setup: Port 1a is the BAS port: EIA-485 for BACnet MS/TP (or N2), set by DIP switches, with baud 9600, 19.2k, 38.4k or 76.8k. It ships set to BACnet at 38,400 baud. (From AG1568EW, written for the single-compressor UPC.)
Port 1a can instead be jumpered for ARC156 (BACnet over ARCNET at 156 kbps). A LonWorks plug-in card uses port 1b and disables port 1a.
The MAC address is set on two rotary switches (tens and ones), 1 from the factory and 99 at most. The UPC only reads a new address after a power cycle.
The device instance is built from the network number and the MAC: network 7000 with MAC 12 gives 7012.
Wiring: 22 or 24 AWG shielded twisted pair, daisy-chained, polarity-sensitive (Net+, Net-, shield). About 30 devices and 2,000 ft per trunk; every MAC on a trunk must be unique.
gotchas: BV 600 econ_on_c only matters when the economizer runs in slave mode (MSV 600 = 6).
Dip switch overrides only pass to the ABC while the dip switch override enable (BV 318) is on; record the physical switch settings first.
Alarm reset: command BV 130 On, then back to Off.
In the source, hp_hdw points are described as the LP input and lp_hdw points as the HP input; verify on site.
The alarm table lists the AV codes only; the MSV lockout point is marked 'do not map'.
